test_title: PYST 13: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
If ‘G @ T’ means ‘G is the father of T’,

‘G % T’ means ‘G is the wife of T’,

‘G # T’ means ‘G is the daughter of T’, and

‘G * T’ means ‘G is the son of T’,

then which of the following options is true based on the expression 'L * M @ N % O * P'?

options.text: N is the mother of L.
N is the daughter-in-law of P.
O is the son of M.
O is the brother of L.

solution:
For this question, we use the table given below-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/351a218420b0cd3eeac9603e951c5a884ce9e0156274ce105e1b0536d1195bb5.png]

By using the symbols given in the above table we solve the expression, L * M @ N % O * P as-

L * M

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcd445424ffbdc16d7f999bbc06b9d2af191ae7ec2e131fb37b104cefceae96f.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e9bb68b9f51be466197b86dc28a772b24df5be559deb7d7296f8eff477614cd.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76fadc267fe71d078606576715b16ddd8d05982f56210fa2b0ea399a0a176a0b.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4abf49112acc3e0f9dd5f4e3696803ada3be376030ee39bf83094d9da5668532.png] 

From the above diagram, we can say that **N is the daughter-in-law of P**.

Hence, **Option (2)** is correct.
